expert.name: Eleni
expert.quote: The mainland is the half of Greece most people skip. Olympia and Delphi are quieter than the Acropolis and twice as atmospheric.
expert.tip: Carry a hat and water for Olympia and Delphi. Both sites are open ground with almost no shade, and the middle of the day is punishing in summer.

summary: Six days across classical Greece: the Acropolis and its museum in Athens, the Corinth Canal, Epidaurus and Mycenae on the road west, the sanctuary at Olympia, and the oracle at Delphi before the mountain road back.
included: Included: 3 nights in Athens, 1 night at Olympia and 1 night at Delphi with breakfast; two dinners on the mainland tour; private airport and port transfers; ferry tickets between the islands; all sightseeing as listed with entrance fees where stated; daily breakfast; a guided Athens city tour with the Acropolis Museum; the three day coach tour of the Peloponnese and Delphi.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are named on confirmation: the operator quotes a standard class rather than fixed properties.
